purpose: Prevent the preregistered pre-training Qwen3.5-0.8B matched baseline from being silently interpreted as proof of the optimal checkpoint to fine-tune for the finished Xeno/EntityOS HCU cognitive-process substrate.

material_distinction.pretrain_baseline_question: Which exact candidate is presently eligible and strongest on the frozen pre-training capability/epistemic/harness baseline under identical evaluation conditions?
material_distinction.training_substrate_question: Which eligible exact candidate learns the intended HCU/Hyperposition/ClayCode cognitive-process behavior most efficiently under an equal admissible training budget while retaining mandatory epistemic, authority, structural and general capabilities?
material_distinction.reason: Fine-tuning changes model parameters and interactions; initial/frozen behavior does not by itself measure adaptation efficiency, forgetting, interference or final post-training capability under the actual training regime.

external_method_inputs.source: Tamkin, Singh, Giovanardi & Goodman, Findings of EMNLP 2020, Investigating Transferability in Pretrained Language Models
external_method_inputs.finding_used: High probing performance in pretrained BERT layers was neither necessary nor sufficient for downstream fine-tuned accuracy, and the benefit of pretrained parameters changed with fine-tuning data size.
external_method_inputs.project_implication: Do not equate static/baseline competence with adaptation value.

external_method_inputs.source: Deshpande et al., 2021, A linearized framework and a new benchmark for model selection for fine-tuning
external_method_inputs.finding_used: Selecting a pretrained model for downstream fine-tuning is a distinct model-selection problem whose useful preselection metrics are evaluated by correlation with actual fine-tuning accuracy.
external_method_inputs.project_implication: Final substrate selection should be validated against actual matched adaptation after trustworthy data/training gates open.

hypothesis: The candidate that clears all mandatory pre-training floors and ranks highest on the frozen matched baseline will also provide the best sample-efficient and retention-safe HCU specialization substrate.
counterhypothesis: A lower-scoring but baseline-eligible candidate, especially the base checkpoint, may adapt more efficiently or retain the required epistemic/authority substrate better under equal training budget than a more posttrained or low-refusal checkpoint; conversely a baseline leader may exhibit greater catastrophic forgetting or shortcut uptake.

lifecycle_revision.scope_clarification: Its winner is PRETRAIN_BASELINE_WINNER / BASELINE_ELIGIBILITY_WINNER. It is not yet FINAL_TRAINING_SUBSTRATE unless a successor experiment establishes adaptation/retention transfer or an explicit owner authority accepts baseline-only selection.

execution_preconditions: P0 OBSERVED instance authentication closed repository-bound
P1 authenticated complete ordered nonempty history closed where relevant to labels
P1.5 reference-labeler exact-merge contract implementation and full-suite closure
small training corpus admitted through exact provenance/leakage/tokenizer/split gates
pre-training baseline completed with exact eligible candidate set
zero-cost local training surface remains explicitly authorized under then-current supervisor authority
proposed_future_p2b.candidate_set_rule: Only checkpoints that pass every mandatory pre-training hard floor enter P2b. A catastrophic baseline failure cannot be rescued by adaptation performance without a newer preregistered authority change.
matched_training_budget: same admitted training families/rows and exact rendered bytes per candidate where ABI compatibility permits
same number of effective training tokens/examples
same adaptation class (full-FT or PEFT) and matched trainable-parameter policy
same step or token budget and checkpoint/evaluation schedule
same seed family with >=2 independent seeds when computationally feasible before promotion
candidate-specific technical necessities must be preregistered as explicit factors, never silently tuned
measurements: gain from each candidate's own pre-training baseline
resource shadow kept separate from semantic score
proposed_future_p2b.selection_rule_shape: A final training-substrate decision must satisfy all mandatory floors after adaptation and then prefer robust fresh-holdout target quality plus sample efficiency and retention; aggregate mean must not compensate for catastrophic epistemic/authority/ABI failure.

anti_goodhart: Do not tune the micro-adaptation corpus separately for each checkpoint.
Do not choose the baseline leader by label/reputation before matched evaluation.
Do not use the inspected TARGET_MEASURED 8-case pilot as P2b holdout.
Do not allow low refusal to compensate for fabricated facts, authority promotion, stale-state acceptance or ABI failure.
Do not select by absolute post-adaptation score alone; report starting score, gain, forgetting and worst-bucket behavior.
Do not execute P2b on synthetic/source-candidate rows that have not passed current training admission gates.
relationship_to_finished_xeno: This distinction optimizes for the actual trained Xeno/HCU module rather than for whichever checkpoint looks best before specialization. It preserves the current baseline as a safety/eligibility discriminator while adding a later empirical test of learnability and retention under the real intended adaptation regime.

training_effect.reason: P2b is future methodology only; current provenance, labeler, corpus and input-identity gates remain open.

next_exact_action: Keep P0/P1/P1.5 as the immediate executable frontier. Complete P2 baseline identity/evaluation preparation in parallel, but label any resulting winner as a pre-training baseline/eligibility winner. After a small trustworthy admitted corpus exists, preregister and run P2b matched micro-adaptation before treating any checkpoint as the final training substrate.
